content: On reception of request for DM54 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according Table 1 column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall use the common sequence of chapter 7.5.1 ‘DTC status’ with the parameters ‘DTCStatusFilter’, 'DTCOrigin' and ‘DTCKind’ according to table Table 2 .
